name: Ferienheim Wildmoos
beschreibung: The Ferienheim Wildmoos is a holiday home in Tirol, designed as self-catering accommodation. The location in the Alpen offers access to hiking trails in summer and ski areas in winter. The amenities include a fully equipped kitchen, several bedrooms, and a living area. The quiet surroundings promote a relaxing atmosphere for guests. The accommodation is suitable for families and groups planning a close-to-nature stay. A garden or terrace complements the offering for outdoor activities.
